$comment: Single shared system/artifact model for HBCI-01. Read by scripts/ (golden model, artifact checks), the studio (src/model/system.ts) and docs. Change values here, not in copies.

mission.permanent: Level 4 integrated biological and artificial cognition.
mission.v0_3_deliverable: A waveform-preserving, multichannel neural readout and representation processor, connected to an interactive 3D engineering-and-learning studio.
mission.objective: HBCI-01 exists to investigate how neural recordings can be processed and communicated efficiently without unnecessarily destroying information needed by downstream decoders.
not_in_scope: neural stimulation or any tissue connection
threshold-based 'mental password' or neural wake word
on-chip manifold alignment or language-model inference (a quantised linear/MLP decoder IS on chip since v0.4)
implant-safety verdicts from a universal power threshold

evidence.CONCEPT: Illustrative geometry or a design idea. Not implemented.
evidence.DEMO: Independent browser simulation. Educational, not the Verilog.
evidence.SCRIPTED: A pre-written illustration of a future interaction. No neural data or model inference behind it.
evidence.SYNTH: Actual Yosys-synthesised logic (generic gates or SKY130 cells).
evidence.LAYOUT: Genuine PDK physical-design output (GDSII). Not fabricated.
evidence.MEASURED: Measured on real hardware. Nothing qualifies yet.

synthetic_teaching.description: Synthetic development profile used by the RTL tests, the trace and the DEMO model. Not a property of any real recording.

EVENT.summary: Legacy threshold-event core (comparator). Lossy: waveform discarded.

RAW.summary: Every digital sample entering the core, with channel and sample index, while a capture session is enabled.

FEATURE.summary: Causal band-pass (biquad) and per-window band energy. Lossy: the waveform cannot be reconstructed from energies.

HYBRID.summary: RAW plus FEATURE for diagnostics. Increases payload compared with RAW alone.

fields.name: flags
fields.meaning: bit0 sat (FEATURE: filter or energy saturated in the window); bit1 gap (records of this type were dropped since the last emitted one)

fields.name: seq
fields.meaning: per-type sequence number; increments for every generated record, including dropped ones

fields.name: ts
fields.meaning: sample index (RAW: this sample; FEATURE: last sample of the window; EVENT: crossing sample)

fields.name: data
fields.meaning: RAW: sign-extended sample; EVENT: {15'b0, polarity, magnitude[15:0]}; FEATURE: band energy (unsigned, saturated)

record.$comment_bits: 2+3+4+16+32+32 = 89 bits of fields. A link layer would add framing; payload calculations in the studio use these 89 bits unless stated.

feature.filter: 2nd-order IIR band-pass, direct form I, RBJ cookbook constant-peak-gain design via bilinear transform

measured_response_of_quantised_coefficie.note: Single biquad: a coarse band selector with gentle skirts, not a sharp high-gamma filter.

feature.arithmetic: acc = b0*x + b1*x1 + b2*x2 - a1*y1 - a2*y2 (exact, 35-bit signed); y = sat16((acc + 8192) >>> 14)
feature.energy: per channel: E = sum over 2^win_log2 samples of y^2 (exact, 48-bit); output = sat32(E >> energy_shift)

legacy_event_core.status: Unchanged from v0.2; kept as the EVENT comparator.

BISC_2025.note: External reference for scale literacy only. HBCI-01 implements 8 processing channels.

loop.name: Neural recordings
loop.note: Electrodes, analog front end and ADC are not implemented.

loop.name: HBCI chip
loop.note: Preserve samples, extract numerical features, organise output records.

loop.name: On-chip neural decoder (v0.4)
loop.note: hbci_ai_decoder: quantised linear/MLP inference on the chip's FEATURE windows (docs/AI_DECODER.md). Predictions are a task-variable estimate, not automatically correct.

loop.name: Larger external decoder
loop.note: Bigger models consuming the chip's RAW/FEATURE records. Not implemented.

loop.name: External language model
loop.note: Reasons over an authorised request. The studio shows a scripted example only.

loop.name: Feedback interface
loop.note: Research branch. Software-only contract (ready / uncertain / request clarification). Not a neural sensation; no stimulation.
